scientific_integrity: Analytic stationary matrix, faithful-state uniqueness argument, concurrence proof and standalone symbolic/numeric checker. No claim of independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Exactly pure marginal-preserving first-qubit reset; equal positive longitudinal fields and positive XX coupling; strictly positive reset rate; no other dissipation; stationarity, not transient entanglement. Publication priority independently unverified.
title: A sharp entanglement-death frontier for one-sided resetting of a coupled qubit pair
